en: Given the root of a binary search tree and the lowest and highest boundaries as low and high, trim the tree so that all its elements lies in [low, high]. Trimming the tree should not change the relative structure of the elements that will remain in the tree (i.e., any node's descendant should remain a descendant). It can be proven that there is a unique answer.
Return the root of the trimmed binary search tree. Note that the root may change depending on the given bounds.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 104].
The value of each node in the tree is unique.
root is guaranteed to be a valid binary search tree.
title: Trim a Binary Search Tree
